stem: Applicants will not be served ___ they bring a valid ID, so please check your wallet before you join the line.
hints: The second part tells you to check your wallet. Why would you need to?
Bringing an ID is a condition for being served. Which connector means 'except if'?
Name the link, then test each connector in the blank. Keep the one where 'not served' and 'bring a valid ID' make sense together.

solution.methodName: Name the link, then pick the connector

steps.action: Split into ideas: (1) applicants will not be served; (2) they bring a valid ID.
Use the clue: 'so please check your wallet'. This shows an ID is required.
steps.why: You check your wallet only when you need to bring something.

steps.action: Name the link: a condition. Bringing an ID is the only way to be served.

steps.why: 'Not served unless you bring an ID' means the same as 'served only if you bring an ID'.

steps.action: Reread: 'Applicants will not be served unless they bring a valid ID, so please check your wallet...'

trapNotes.if: 'Not served if they bring a valid ID' means bringing an ID stops you from being served. That is the reverse of the meaning.
trapNotes.although: Although shows contrast: 'not served even though they bring an ID'. Then checking your wallet would be pointless.
trapNotes.because: Because gives a reason: 'not served because they bring an ID'. An ID is never a reason to refuse service.
